decisions.reason: The net price display plugin sits within the firm's core shop-extension know-how and is cheap to maintain, but its absence from the website in 2020 and 2021 raises the risk that it is being phased out.

The ERP interface draws on deep integration knowledge and recurring client demand, and the firm's own development can adapt it to new shop versions, although it was not visible on the website recently.

Portal-specific price comparison tracking depends on outside platforms and shop versions that keep changing, and with no recent visibility the firm likely consolidates the overlapping tracking plugins into its analytics services.
This sibling tracking plugin adds little new knowledge, has not been visible since 2019, and its resources are better used for multichannel and mobile commerce work.
A third portal-specific tracking variant is the most likely target for pruning given the overlap with its siblings, changes on the portals and its absence from the website.
Net price reporting complements the display plugin and uses the same knowledge base, so it stays despite uncertainty from its missing recent website presence.
